title: stelis erucosa
intro: Stelis erucosa, commonly known as the Bitter Honey Flower or Bitter Honey Orchid, is a species of orchid native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Stelis erucosa include its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a potential remedy for digestive disorders, fever, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Stelis erucosa are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which also contribute to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
